title: Quiz & Identification View
description: Walkthrough of the core interactive photo quiz canvas, keyboard shortcuts, multi-rank validation, and structured hint mechanics.

steps.title: Photo Inspection Canvas & Map Toggle
steps.description: Inspect the observation photographs and use the map when coordinates are available. Use Left/Right Arrow or A/D to change photos while the identification input is not selected. Observation details and the GBIF link provide context and attribution.

steps.title: Interactive Multi-Word Autocomplete
steps.description: Click 'Identify Taxon', or press /, F2, or Ctrl+K to focus it. Enter a scientific name or an available vernacular name for a species, genus, or family. Choose your display language in Settings & Data. Autocomplete matches name prefixes; select a suggestion or press Enter to choose the first result. With no result shown, Enter submits the typed guess. Press Esc to leave the input.

steps.title: Multi-Rank Taxonomic Hierarchy Feedback
steps.description: Guesses can be submitted at any rank (Family, Genus, Species). The visual hierarchy feedback tree highlights correct rank matches (green), incorrect guesses (red), and unrevealed scope.

steps.title: Structured Hints & Diagnostic Comparisons
steps.description: Reveal the next higher-order rank or request up to five multiple-choice candidates within the revealed scope. Fewer choices may appear in a small training pool. Hints and diagnostic comparison photos, including comparisons revealed after a wrong guess, mark the attempt as assisted and exclude it from unassisted success metrics.

steps.title: Streak & Record Tracking
steps.description: Track your current streak and personal best. GBIF photographs may be ambiguous or incorrectly labelled, so you can manually override how an observation is counted. This is for your own training and judgment. You can also skip an observation you do not want to practise.

steps.title: Next observation
steps.description: Click 'Next Observation', or press Ctrl+Right Arrow or N while the identification input is not selected. Press Esc to leave the input before using navigation shortcuts.
